newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar tightly mixed in slight activity.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar tightly mixed in slight activity.

text.p: White sugar futures nudged into positive territory in listless Friday afternoon activity as the expected weakness on the New York market failed to materialise, traders said.
Spread dealings were the order of the day with August/October, March/December, October/December and May/August 1998 all attracting commission house interest.
Some trade buying was noted in August earlier in the session but this quickly subsided, traders said. Little activity was expected in London ahead of Britain's public holiday on May 5.
"I don't know what to expect now...we might have a quieter day today," said one trader.
Other traders said they expected to see some weakness on July raws as positions were adjusted after the large delivery of south Brazilian raws against the May expiry.
"Whites seem to be one step back from the raws activity at the moment...but there's nothing to say what the whites are going to do," said one trader.
At 1440 GMT positions were tightly mixed. August was down 20 cents at $310.50 and October up by the same amount at $301.50. Volume amounted 1,289 lots.
Paris volume reached a scant 170 lots. August was down $1.90 at $310.10 and October was untraded.
